title: Pilot of the Airwaves
summary: A TV presenter is found strangled in her pool. A famous TV personality is suspected of the crime but the team struggles to break his alibi because he was on-air.
method: The killer went to the victim's house early, strangled the victim, and put her body in the sauna to manipulate the time of death. He then went back to the station and went on air. His daughter was the accomplice and put on the victim's clothes to impersonate her and fake the time of death. She pushed the body in the pool and yelled out to the runner to make it look like the murder just happened. She pre-recorded a clip of herself from the afternoon before to put on air.
motive: The victim was about to run a story about how the killer had a pattern of sexual harassment towards interns.
killer: A popular TV personality and his daughter
notes:
Florence returns to the team. This is also where she meets Neville for the first time. It's interesting how his character changed from this hypochondriac to awkward later on. 
It's explained that Madeline went to France and got Ruby a secondment. It's a 3-person team this episode, not including Selwyn.
